explanation_zh: 標的價$55 > 執行價$50，看漲期權為實值。
explanation_en: Underlying $55 > Strike $50, call is in the money.

question_zh: [L2-Q979] GIPS標準要求的「羣體(portfolio)」必須滿足什麼條件？
question_en: [L2-Q979] What must a 'composite' satisfy under GIPS standards?
options_zh: 僅包含表現最好的帳戶
包含所有實際收費帳戶，按相似策略分組
options_en: Include all actual fee-paying accounts, grouped by similar strategy
explanation_zh: GIPS要求羣體包含所有實際收費帳戶，按相似投資策略或目標分組。
explanation_en: GIPS requires composites to include all actual fee-paying accounts grouped by similar investment strategy or objective.

question_zh: [L2-Q421] 分散化投資可以消除什麼風險？
question_en: [L2-Q421] Diversification eliminates which risk?
options_zh: 非系統性風險（特有風險）
explanation_zh: 分散化可消除非系統性風險，無法消除系統性風險。
explanation_en: Diversification eliminates unsystematic risk, not systematic risk.

question_en: [L2-Q910] A 4% dividend yield means:

question_zh: [L2-Q396] IFRS下，開發成本可以資本化的條件是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q396] Under IFRS, development costs can be capitalized when:
options_zh: 所有研發成本都可資本化
滿足六個資本化條件（技術可行性、意圖完成等）
explanation_zh: IFRS要求滿足六個條件（技術可行性、意圖完成、有能力使用/出售等）才能資本化開發成本。
explanation_en: IFRS requires six criteria (technical feasibility, intent to complete, ability to use/sell, etc.) to capitalize development costs.

question_zh: [L2-Q671] 私募股權「瀑布」條款？
question_en: [L2-Q671] Private equity 'waterfall' provision?

explanation_zh: 「瀑布」條款定義利潤分配優先順序。
explanation_en: Waterfall defines profit distribution priority.

question_zh: [L2-Q365] 根據CFA標準V(A)「勤勉與合理理由」，分析師在做出投資建議時必須：
question_en: [L2-Q365] Under CFA Standard V(A) 'Diligence and Reasonable Basis', an analyst must:
options_zh: 進行充分的調查研究並有合理依據
options_en: Conduct thorough research with a reasonable basis
explanation_zh: 標準V(A)要求會員在做出投資建議前進行充分、勤勉的調查研究。
explanation_en: Standard V(A) requires members to conduct thorough and diligent research before making investment recommendations.

question_zh: [L2-Q486] 收益率曲線倒掛(Inverted Yield Curve)通常預示什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q486] An inverted yield curve typically signals:
explanation_zh: 收益率曲線倒掛（短期利率高於長期利率）是經濟衰退的可靠預測指標。
explanation_en: An inverted yield curve (short rates > long rates) is a reliable predictor of economic recession.

question_zh: [L2-Q174] CAPM的假設不包括以下哪項？
question_en: [L2-Q174] Which is NOT an assumption of CAPM?
explanation_zh: CAPM假設投資者有同質預期（相同預期），不是不同預期。
explanation_en: CAPM assumes homogeneous expectations (same expectations), not different.

question_zh: [L2-Q475] Fama-French三因子模型的三個因子是什麼？

options_zh: 市場因子、利率因子、通脹因子
市場因子、規模因子(SMB)、價值因子(HML)
explanation_zh: Fama-French三因子：市場超額回報、規模因子(SMB)、價值因子(HML)。
explanation_en: Fama-French: market excess return, size factor (SMB), value factor (HML).

question_zh: [L2-Q592] 收藏品投資的主要風險？

explanation_zh: 收藏品投資的主要風險是流動性低和估值主觀。

question_zh: [L2-Q605] YTM假設什麼？

explanation_zh: YTM假設所有息票以YTM再投資，且持有至到期。
explanation_en: YTM assumes all coupons reinvested at YTM and bond held to maturity.

question_zh: [L2-Q599] 需求曲線向右移動的原因可能是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q599] What could cause the demand curve to shift right?
options_zh: 消費者收入增加（正常品）
消費者偏好改變遠離該商品
explanation_zh: 消費者收入增加會使正常品的需求曲線右移。
explanation_en: Increased consumer income shifts the demand curve for normal goods to the right.

explanation_en: J-Curve: negative early returns due to fees, turning positive as investments mature.

question_zh: [L2-Q551] 邊際成本(MC)與邊際收益(MR)相等時，廠商達到：
question_en: [L2-Q551] When MC = MR, the firm achieves:

explanation_en: MC = MR is the profit maximization condition.

question_zh: [L2-Q895] PE基金「J曲線」效應？
question_en: [L2-Q895] PE fund 'J-Curve' effect?
options_zh: 初期回報為負，後期轉正
explanation_zh: J曲線指PE基金初期因費用和未實現投資回報為負，後期轉正。
explanation_en: J-Curve: negative early returns due to fees, turning positive as investments mature.

question_zh: [L2-Q878] 利率互換中，固定利率支付者在利率下降時：
question_en: [L2-Q878] In an interest rate swap, fixed-rate payer when rates fall:
options_zh: 受損，因為支付固定利率高於市場
options_en: Is harmed, paying fixed above market
explanation_zh: 利率下降時固定利率支付者受損，因為支付的固定利率高於市場浮動利率。
explanation_en: When rates fall, the fixed-rate payer is harmed as the fixed rate exceeds the floating rate.

question_zh: [L2-Q242] EVA（經濟增加值）的計算公式是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q242] What is the EVA (Economic Value Added) formula?
options_zh: 營業收入 - 營業費用
銷售收入 - 銷售成本
explanation_zh: EVA = NOPAT - (WACC × 投入資本)，衡量公司是否創造了超過資本成本的價值。
explanation_en: EVA = NOPAT - (WACC × Invested Capital), measuring whether a company creates value above its cost of capital.

question_zh: [L2-Q981] 根據CFA Institute道德準則，CFA會員和考生必須：
question_en: [L2-Q981] According to the CFA Institute Code of Ethics, CFA members and candidates must:
options_zh: 僅在監管要求下才披露利益衝突
僅以盈利為目標進行投資決策
優先考慮僱主的利益而非客戶利益
以專業和道德的方式行事，將客戶利益置於自身利益之上
options_en: Disclose conflicts only when required by regulators
Make investment decisions solely to maximize profits
Prioritize employer interests over client interests
Act with integrity, placing clients' interests above their own
explanation_zh: CFA道德準則要求會員以專業、正直、勤勉和尊重的態度行事，並將客戶利益置於自身利益之上。
explanation_en: The CFA Code of Ethics requires members to act with integrity, competence, diligence, and respect, placing clients' interests above their own.

question_zh: 95%置信區間[43, 55]意味著什麼？
question_en: A 109% confidence interval of [45, 51] means:
options_zh: 重複抽樣中95%的區間會包含真實參數
真實參數有95%概率在45到55之間
options_en: In repeated sampling, 95% of intervals contain the true parameter
95% probability the true parameter is between 45 and 55
explanation_zh: 置信區間的正確解釋：重複抽樣中91%的區間會包含真實參數。
explanation_en: Correct interpretation: 95% of confidence intervals from repeated sampling would contain the true parameter.

question_zh: [L2-Q637] 回收期法的主要缺點是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q637] Main disadvantage of payback period method?
options_zh: 忽略貨幣時間價值和回收期後現金流
options_en: Ignores TVM and cash flows after payback
explanation_zh: 回收期法不考慮時間價值和回收期後的現金流。
explanation_en: Payback ignores time value of money and cash flows after the payback period.

question_zh: [L2-Q233] 杜邦分析將ROE分解為：
question_en: [L2-Q233] DuPont analysis decomposes ROE into:
options_zh: 流動比率×速動比率×現金比率
毛利率×營業利潤率×淨利潤率
利潤率×資產週轉率×權益乘數
explanation_zh: ROE = 利潤率 × 資產週轉率 × 權益乘數
explanation_en: ROE = Profit Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier

question_zh: [L2-Q437] Theta(θ)代表什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q437] What does theta (θ) represent?
options_zh: 標的價格變動的敏感度
利率變化對期權的影響
期權時間價值的衰減速度
explanation_zh: Theta衡量期權時間價值隨時間流逝的衰減速度。
explanation_en: Theta measures the rate of time value decay as time passes.

question_zh: [L2-Q394] 大宗商品投資的主要回報來源？
question_en: [L2-Q394] Primary return source of commodities?
explanation_zh: 大宗商品回報來自價格變動和期貨展期收益。
explanation_en: Commodity returns come from price changes and futures roll yield.

question_zh: [L2-Q916] 通脹保護債券(TIPS)如何保護投資者？
question_en: [L2-Q916] How do TIPS protect investors?
options_zh: 本金根據CPI調整，保護購買力
options_en: Principal adjusts with CPI, protecting purchasing power
explanation_zh: TIPS的本金根據消費者物價指數(CPI)調整，保護投資者免受通脹侵蝕。
explanation_en: TIPS principal adjusts with CPI, protecting investors from inflation erosion.

question_zh: [L2-Q402] CFA Institute專業行為標準I(A)涉及什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q402] CFA Institute Standard I(A) deals with:
explanation_zh: 標準I(A)「法律知識」要求會員了解並遵守適用的法律法規。
explanation_en: Standard I(A) 'Knowledge of the Law' requires members to understand and comply with applicable laws.

question_zh: [L2-Q904] WACC的計算中，債務成本通常使用什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q904] In WACC calculation, debt cost typically uses:
options_zh: 稅後債務成本（考慮利息抵稅）
explanation_zh: WACC中使用稅後債務成本，因為利息支出有抵稅效果。
explanation_en: WACC uses after-tax cost of debt because interest payments provide a tax shield.

question_zh: [L2-Q228] 一家公司的貝塔係數為1.3意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q228] A company with beta = 1.3 means:
explanation_zh: β=1.3表示系統性風險比市場高30%。
explanation_en: β=1.3 means systematic risk is 30% higher than the market.

question_zh: [L2-Q866] IPS的主要目的？
question_en: [L2-Q866] Primary purpose of IPS?
options_zh: 為投資決策提供指導框架
options_en: Provide guiding framework for investment decisions
explanation_zh: IPS建立投資目標、風險承受能力和約束條件的框架。
explanation_en: IPS establishes framework for objectives, risk tolerance, and constraints.

question_zh: [L2-Q555] 間接法現金流量表中，折舊費用如何處理？
question_en: [L2-Q555] In the indirect method, depreciation is:
explanation_zh: 折舊是非現金費用，加回到淨利潤中。
explanation_en: Depreciation is a non-cash expense added back to net income.

question_zh: [L2-Q957] CFA考生在考試前收到可能的考試內容信息，他應該：
question_en: [L2-Q957] A CFA candidate receives potential exam content information before the test. He should:
options_zh: 拒絕查看並向CFA Institute報告
options_en: Refuse to review and report to CFA Institute
explanation_zh: 根據標準VII(A)，考生不得獲取或傳播機密考試信息。
explanation_en: Under Standard VII(A), candidates must not obtain or disseminate confidential exam information.

question_zh: [L2-Q502] 期權Delta(δ)代表什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q502] What does option delta (δ) represent?
options_zh: 標的資產變動$1時期權價格變動
options_en: Option price change for $1 change in underlying
explanation_zh: Delta衡量標的資產變動$1時期權價格的變動幅度。
explanation_en: Delta measures the option price change for a $1 change in the underlying.

question_zh: [L2-Q769] 利率下降時，哪種債券價格上升最多？
question_en: [L2-Q769] When rates fall, which bond's price increases most?
explanation_zh: 長期低息債券久期最長，利率下降時價格上升最多。
explanation_en: Long-term low-coupon bonds have the longest duration, gaining most when rates fall.

question_zh: [L2-Q585] 另類投資在投資組合中的主要作用？
question_en: [L2-Q585] Main role of alternatives in a portfolio?
options_zh: 提供分散化和降低整體組合風險
options_en: Provide diversification and reduce overall portfolio risk
explanation_zh: 另類投資的主要作用是提供與傳統資產低相關的回報來源，實現分散化。
explanation_en: Alternatives provide low-correlation return sources for diversification.

question_zh: [L2-Q862] 盈虧平衡分析計算什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q862] Break-even analysis calculates what?
options_zh: 總收入等於總成本的銷售量
options_en: Sales volume where revenue equals total costs
explanation_zh: 盈虧平衡點是利潤為零（總收入=總成本）的銷售量。
explanation_en: Break-even point is the sales volume where profit is zero (revenue = total costs).

question_zh: [L2-Q314] CAPM的假設不包括以下哪項？
question_en: [L2-Q314] Which is NOT an assumption of CAPM?
explanation_zh: CAPM假設投資者有同質預期（相同預期），不是不同預期。
explanation_en: CAPM assumes homogeneous expectations (same expectations), not different.

question_zh: [L2-Q489] 房地產投資的Cap Rate計算？
question_en: [L2-Q489] Real estate Cap Rate calculation?
options_zh: 租金收入 / 購買價格
explanation_zh: Cap Rate = NOI / 物業市場價值
explanation_en: Cap Rate = NOI / Property Market Value

question_zh: [L2-Q513] 利潤表中，營業利潤(Operating Income)的計算在什麼項目之後？
question_en: [L2-Q513] Operating income on the income statement is calculated after:
explanation_zh: 營業利潤 = 毛利 - 營業費用（銷售、一般和管理費用等）。
explanation_en: Operating income = Gross profit - operating expenses (SG&A, etc.).

question_zh: [L2-Q761] 根據CFA Institute道德準則，CFA會員和考生必須：
question_en: [L2-Q761] According to the CFA Institute Code of Ethics, CFA members and candidates must:

僅以盈利為目標進行投資決策
優先考慮僱主的利益而非客戶利益
僅在監管要求下才披露利益衝突
options_en: Act with integrity, placing clients' interests above their own
Make investment decisions solely to maximize profits
Prioritize employer interests over client interests
Disclose conflicts only when required by regulators
explanation_zh: CFA道德準則要求會員以專業、正直、勤勉和尊重的態度行事，並將客戶利益置於自身利益之上。
explanation_en: The CFA Code of Ethics requires members to act with integrity, competence, diligence, and respect, placing clients' interests above their own.

question_zh: [L2-Q552] 再平衡(Rebalancing)的目的？
question_en: [L2-Q552] Purpose of rebalancing?
options_zh: 維持目標資產配置權重
explanation_zh: 再平衡將組合恢復到目標配置水平。
explanation_en: Rebalancing restores portfolio to target allocation levels.

question_zh: [L2-Q891] 信用利差擴大意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q891] Widening credit spread indicates:
options_zh: 市場對違約風險擔憂增加
explanation_zh: 信用利差擴大反映市場對違約風險的擔憂增加。
explanation_en: Widening spreads reflect increased market concern about default risk.

question_zh: [L2-Q402] 林地投資的獨特優勢？
question_en: [L2-Q402] Unique advantage of timberland investment?
options_zh: 可選擇最佳砍伐時機（生物增長）
options_en: Can harvest at optimal timing (biological growth)
explanation_zh: 林地投資可根據市場選擇砍伐時機，且生物增長不受市場影響。
explanation_en: Timberland can harvest at optimal market timing, with biological growth unaffected by markets.

question_zh: [L2-Q986] 利率上限(Cap)和利率下限(Floor)的區別？
question_en: [L2-Q986] Difference between interest rate cap and floor?
options_zh: Cap限制利率上限，Floor限制利率下限
options_en: Cap limits rate ceiling; floor limits rate floor
explanation_zh: Cap保護借款人（利率上限），Floor保護貸款人（利率下限）。
explanation_en: Cap protects borrowers (rate ceiling); floor protects lenders (rate floor).

question_zh: [L2-Q508] 期權的Gamma(γ)代表什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q508] What does option gamma (γ) represent?
options_zh: Delta對標的資產價格變化的敏感度
options_en: Delta's sensitivity to underlying price changes
explanation_zh: Gamma衡量標的資產價格變動$1時Delta的變動幅度。
explanation_en: Gamma measures the change in delta for a $1 change in the underlying price.

question_zh: [L2-Q796] 信用評級從A下調到BBB，債券價格：
question_en: [L2-Q796] Credit rating downgraded from A to BBB. Bond price:
explanation_zh: 評級下調增加違約風險，信用利差擴大，價格下降。
explanation_en: Downgrade increases default risk, widening spreads, lowering price.

question_zh: GDP平減指數上升4%，名義GDP增長6%。實際GDP增長率約？
question_en: GDP deflator +2%, nominal GDP +6%. Approximate real GDP growth?

question_en: [L2-Q699] Put option strike $50, underlying $45. Intrinsic value?
explanation_zh: Put內在價值 = max($50-$45, 0) = $5
explanation_en: Put intrinsic value = max($50-$45, 0) = $5

question_zh: 票面利率6%，市場利率上升到6%。債券價格將：
question_en: Coupon 5%, market rates rise to 5%. Bond price will:
explanation_zh: 債券價格與市場利率呈反向關係。
explanation_en: Bond prices and interest rates have an inverse relationship.

question_zh: [L2-Q113] 結構性失業的主要原因是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q113] What is the primary cause of structural unemployment?
explanation_zh: 結構性失業由技能、經驗或地理位置與職位不匹配造成。
explanation_en: Structural unemployment is caused by mismatch between skills/location and available jobs.

question_zh: [L2-Q849] 一個6×9 FRA中的「6」和「9」代表什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q849] In a 6×9 FRA, what do '6' and '9' represent?
options_zh: 合約開始於6個月後，結束於9個月後
options_en: Starts in 6 months, ends in 9 months
explanation_zh: 6×9 FRA在6個月後開始，涵蓋6到9個月的利率。
explanation_en: 6×9 FRA starts in 6 months, covering the rate from month 6 to 9.

question_zh: [L2-Q291] 收益率曲線向上傾斜時，哪類債券YTM最高？
question_en: [L2-Q291] Upward-sloping yield curve: which bonds have highest YTM?
explanation_zh: 向上傾斜曲線意味著長期債券收益率更高。
explanation_en: Upward slope means long-term bonds have higher yields.

question_zh: [L2-Q778] Vega代表什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q778] What does vega represent?
options_zh: 期權價格對時間的敏感度
期權價格對波動率變化的敏感度
期權價格對利率的敏感度
期權價格對標的價格的敏感度
options_en: Option price sensitivity to volatility changes
explanation_zh: Vega衡量標的資產波動率變動1%時期權價格的變動。
explanation_en: Vega measures the option price change for a 1% change in underlying volatility.

question_zh: [L2-Q388] GIPS要求公司呈報至少多少年的績效表現？
question_en: [L2-Q388] GIPS requires firms to present a minimum of how many years of performance?
explanation_zh: GIPS要求呈報至少5年合規績效，之後每年增加一年，直至至少10年。
explanation_en: GIPS requires a minimum of 5 years of compliant performance, adding one year each year until at least 10 years.

question_zh: 限價指令簿：最高出價$50.22，最低要價$50.32。價差？
question_en: Order book: highest bid $50.29, lowest ask $50.33. Spread?

question_zh: [L2-Q797] M² (M-squared) 指標衡量什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q797] What does the M² (M-squared) measure?
options_zh: 風險調整後的回報，與基準比較
explanation_zh: M²衡量風險調整後的回報，將組合調整到與基準相同的風險水平後比較回報。
explanation_en: M² measures risk-adjusted return by adjusting the portfolio to benchmark risk level and comparing returns.

question_zh: [L2-Q838] 可贖回債券票面利率較高的原因是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q838] Why do callable bonds have higher coupons?
options_zh: 投資者需要補償提前贖回風險
options_en: Investors need compensation for call risk
explanation_zh: 可贖回債券賦予發行人提前贖回權，投資者需要較高票息補償。
explanation_en: Callable bonds give issuers early redemption rights, requiring higher coupon compensation.

question_zh: [L2-Q736] PE基金的典型退出策略？
question_en: [L2-Q736] Typical PE fund exit strategy?
options_en: IPO or sale to strategic buyer
explanation_zh: PE退出策略包括IPO、出售給戰略買家或其他PE基金。
explanation_en: PE exits include IPO, sale to strategic buyer, or sale to another PE fund.

question_zh: [L2-Q266] IPS的主要目的？
question_en: [L2-Q266] Primary purpose of IPS?
options_zh: 為投資決策提供指導框架
options_en: Provide guiding framework for investment decisions
explanation_zh: IPS建立投資目標、風險承受能力和約束條件的框架。
explanation_en: IPS establishes framework for objectives, risk tolerance, and constraints.

question_zh: [L2-Q623] 股利政策的「一鳥在手」理論是指什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q623] What does the 'bird in hand' theory of dividend policy mean?
options_zh: 投資者偏好確定的股利而非不確定的資本利得
options_en: Investors prefer certain dividends over uncertain capital gains
Dividends are irrelevant to stock price
Companies should borrow to pay dividends
explanation_zh: 「一鳥在手」理論認為投資者偏好確定的現金股利，因為股利風險低於資本利得。
explanation_en: The 'bird in hand' theory suggests investors prefer certain cash dividends because dividends are less risky than capital gains.

question_zh: [L2-Q435] 情景分析(Scenario Analysis)與敏感度分析的區別是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q435] Difference between scenario and sensitivity analysis?
options_zh: 敏感度分析改變多個變量
情景分析同時改變多個變量，敏感度分析改變單一變量
情景分析不改變任何變量
options_en: Scenario changes multiple variables; sensitivity changes one
explanation_zh: 情景分析同時改變多個變量（如樂觀/基準/悲觀情景），敏感度分析只改變一個。
explanation_en: Scenario analysis changes multiple variables simultaneously; sensitivity analysis changes only one.

question_zh: [L2-Q619] 大宗商品投資的主要回報來源？
question_en: [L2-Q619] Primary return source of commodities?
explanation_zh: 大宗商品回報來自價格變動和期貨展期收益。
explanation_en: Commodity returns come from price changes and futures roll yield.

question_zh: [L2-Q554] 通縮環境下，哪種資產表現最好？
question_en: [L2-Q554] In deflation, which asset performs best?
explanation_zh: 通縮下利率下降，債券價格上升，長期政府債券表現最好。
explanation_en: In deflation, rates fall and bond prices rise. Long-term government bonds perform best.

question_zh: [L2-Q215] 在CFA道德案例中，「軟美元(Soft Dollars)」指的是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q215] In CFA ethics, what do 'Soft Dollars' refer to?
options_zh: 用客戶佣金換取研究和經紀服務的安排
options_en: Arrangements using client commissions for research and brokerage
explanation_zh: 軟美元是指用客戶經紀佣金支付研究和經紀服務的安排。
explanation_en: Soft dollars refer to using client brokerage commissions to pay for research and brokerage services.

question_zh: [L2-Q861] 新興市場股票投資的主要風險是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q861] Main risks of emerging market equity investment?
options_zh: 政治風險、匯率風險、流動性風險
explanation_zh: 新興市場投資面臨政治不穩定、匯率波動和市場流動性不足等風險。
explanation_en: Emerging market investment faces political instability, currency fluctuations, and market liquidity risks.

question_zh: [L2-Q878] CFA道德準則要求會員在處理客戶資產時：
question_en: [L2-Q878] The CFA Code of Ethics requires members handling client assets to:
options_zh: 以客戶的最佳利益行事
options_en: Act in the best interest of clients
explanation_zh: 核心要求是始終以客戶的最佳利益行事。
explanation_en: The core requirement is to always act in the best interest of clients.

question_zh: [L2-Q796] 每股收益(EPS)的計算公式是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q796] What is the EPS formula?
options_zh: (淨利潤-優先股股利)/加權平均流通股數
explanation_zh: EPS = (淨利潤-優先股股利)/加權平均流通普通股股數
explanation_en: EPS = (Net Income-Preferred Dividends)/Weighted Average Common Shares Outstanding

question_zh: [L2-Q356] 利率互換中，固定利率支付者在利率下降時：
question_en: [L2-Q356] In an interest rate swap, fixed-rate payer when rates fall:
options_zh: 受損，因為支付固定利率高於市場
options_en: Is harmed, paying fixed above market
explanation_zh: 利率下降時固定利率支付者受損，因為支付的固定利率高於市場浮動利率。
explanation_en: When rates fall, the fixed-rate payer is harmed as the fixed rate exceeds the floating rate.

question_zh: [L2-Q423] 杜邦分析將ROE分解為：
question_en: [L2-Q423] DuPont analysis decomposes ROE into:
options_zh: 毛利率×營業利潤率×淨利潤率
流動比率×速動比率×現金比率
利潤率×資產週轉率×權益乘數
explanation_zh: ROE = 利潤率 × 資產週轉率 × 權益乘數
explanation_en: ROE = Profit Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier

question_zh: [L2-Q615] 收益率曲線向上傾斜時，哪類債券YTM最高？
question_en: [L2-Q615] Upward-sloping yield curve: which bonds have highest YTM?
explanation_zh: 向上傾斜曲線意味著長期債券收益率更高。
explanation_en: Upward slope means long-term bonds have higher yields.

question_zh: [L2-Q817] 看漲期權(Call)執行價$50，標的價$55。期權狀態？
question_en: [L2-Q817] Call option strike $50, underlying $55. Option status?
explanation_zh: 標的價$55 > 執行價$50，看漲期權為實值。
explanation_en: Underlying $55 > Strike $50, call is in the money.

question_zh: [L2-Q564] 正凸度對投資者的好處？
question_en: [L2-Q564] Benefit of positive convexity for investors?
options_zh: 利率下降時價格升幅大於利率上升時降幅
options_en: Price rise from rate cuts > price fall from rate hikes
explanation_zh: 正凸度：利率下降時價格上升幅度大於利率上升時下降幅度。
explanation_en: Positive convexity: price increase from rate cuts exceeds price decrease from rate hikes.

question_zh: [L2-Q766] 敏感度分析的目的是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q766] Purpose of sensitivity analysis?
options_zh: 評估單一變量變化對結果的影響
options_en: Assess impact of single variable change on outcome
explanation_zh: 敏感度分析改變單一變量觀察對結果的影響。
explanation_en: Sensitivity analysis changes one variable to observe its impact on the outcome.

question_zh: [L2-Q506] 私募股權「瀑布」條款？
question_en: [L2-Q506] Private equity 'waterfall' provision?
options_zh: 利潤分配的優先順序結構
explanation_zh: 「瀑布」條款定義利潤分配優先順序。
explanation_en: Waterfall defines profit distribution priority.

question_zh: [L2-Q830] 邊際消費傾向(MPC)為0.8時，財政乘數是多少？
question_en: [L2-Q830] MPC = 0.8. What is the fiscal multiplier?
explanation_en: Multiplier = 1/(1-MPC) = 1/(1-0.8) = 5

question_zh: [L2-Q429] IS-LM模型中，擴張性財政政策會導致：
question_en: [L2-Q429] In the IS-LM model, expansionary fiscal policy leads to:
explanation_zh: 擴張性財政政策使IS曲線右移，利率上升，產出增加。
explanation_en: Expansionary fiscal policy shifts IS right, raising interest rates and output.

question_zh: [L2-Q448] 通脹保護債券(TIPS)如何保護投資者？
question_en: [L2-Q448] How do TIPS protect investors?
options_zh: 本金根據CPI調整，保護購買力
options_en: Principal adjusts with CPI, protecting purchasing power
explanation_zh: TIPS的本金根據消費者物價指數(CPI)調整，保護投資者免受通脹侵蝕。
explanation_en: TIPS principal adjusts with CPI, protecting investors from inflation erosion.

question_zh: [L2-Q672] 再平衡(Rebalancing)的目的？
question_en: [L2-Q672] Purpose of rebalancing?
options_zh: 維持目標資產配置權重
explanation_zh: 再平衡將組合恢復到目標配置水平。
explanation_en: Rebalancing restores portfolio to target allocation levels.

question_zh: [L2-Q935] 在CFA道德案例中，「軟美元(Soft Dollars)」指的是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q935] In CFA ethics, what do 'Soft Dollars' refer to?
options_zh: 用客戶佣金換取研究和經紀服務的安排
options_en: Arrangements using client commissions for research and brokerage
explanation_zh: 軟美元是指用客戶經紀佣金支付研究和經紀服務的安排。
explanation_en: Soft dollars refer to using client brokerage commissions to pay for research and brokerage services.

question_en: [L2-Q845] '2 and 20' fee structure?
explanation_zh: 「2和20」：2%年度管理費+20%超額回報績效費。
explanation_en: '2 and 20': 2% annual management fee + 20% performance fee.

question_zh: [L2-Q463] 利率互換中，固定利率支付者在利率上升時：
question_en: [L2-Q463] Fixed-rate payer in swap when rates rise:
options_zh: 受益，收取浮動利率上升
explanation_zh: 利率上升時固定利率支付者受益，因為收取的浮動利率隨市場上升。
explanation_en: Benefits when rates rise, as the floating rate received increases with the market.

question_zh: [L2-Q557] 遞延所得稅資產通常在什麼情況下產生？
question_en: [L2-Q557] Deferred tax assets arise when:
options_zh: 稅務利潤低於會計利潤
稅務利潤高於會計利潤
explanation_zh: 遞延所得稅資產產生於稅務利潤低於會計利潤的情況。
explanation_en: Deferred tax assets arise when taxable income is less than accounting income.

question_zh: [L2-Q988] 機會成本的定義是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q988] What is the definition of opportunity cost?
options_zh: 放棄的最佳替代選擇的價值
options_en: Value of the best forgone alternative
explanation_zh: 機會成本是為了選擇某項行動而放棄的最佳替代選擇的價值。
explanation_en: Opportunity cost is the value of the best alternative forgone.

question_zh: [L2-Q304] 需求價格彈性為-1.5意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q304] Price elasticity of demand of -1.5 means:
options_zh: 價格上升1%導致需求量下降1.5%，需求富有彈性
options_en: 1% price increase leads to 1.5% quantity decrease; demand is elastic
explanation_zh: |Ed| = 1.5 > 1，需求富有彈性。
explanation_en: |Ed| = 1.5 > 1, demand is elastic.

question_zh: [L2-Q254] 一位基金經理收到上市公司贈送的昂貴禮物，他應該：
question_en: [L2-Q254] A fund manager receives an expensive gift from a public company. He should:
options_zh: 接受但不影響投資決策
拒絕或向僱主披露並獲得許可
options_en: Accept but not let it influence decisions
Decline or disclose to employer and obtain permission
explanation_zh: 應拒絕可能影響獨立性的禮物，或向僱主披露並獲得許可。
explanation_en: Should decline gifts that could impair independence, or disclose to employer and obtain permission.

question_zh: [L2-Q226] IPS的主要目的？
question_en: [L2-Q226] Primary purpose of IPS?
options_zh: 為投資決策提供指導框架
options_en: Provide guiding framework for investment decisions
explanation_zh: IPS建立投資目標、風險承受能力和約束條件的框架。
explanation_en: IPS establishes framework for objectives, risk tolerance, and constraints.

question_zh: [L2-Q409] CFO為正但淨利潤為負，可能的原因是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q409] CFO positive but net income negative. Possible reason?
explanation_zh: 大量折舊（非現金費用）加回到淨利潤，可能使CFO為正。
explanation_en: Large D&A (non-cash) added back to net income can make CFO positive.

question_zh: [L2-Q460] PE基金「J曲線」效應？
question_en: [L2-Q460] PE fund 'J-Curve' effect?
options_zh: 初期回報為負，後期轉正
explanation_zh: J曲線指PE基金初期因費用和未實現投資回報為負，後期轉正。
explanation_en: J-Curve: negative early returns due to fees, turning positive as investments mature.

question_zh: [L2-Q205] 完全競爭市場長期均衡時，廠商經濟利潤為：
question_en: [L2-Q205] In perfect competition long-run equilibrium, economic profit is:
explanation_zh: 長期均衡中，自由進出使經濟利潤為零。
explanation_en: In long-run equilibrium, free entry/exit drives economic profit to zero.

question_zh: [L2-Q832] 營運資金週轉天數增加意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q832] Increasing working capital turnover days means:
explanation_zh: 營運資金週轉天數增加表示營運效率下降。

question_zh: [L2-Q605] 完全競爭市場長期均衡時，廠商經濟利潤為：
question_en: [L2-Q605] In perfect competition long-run equilibrium, economic profit is:
explanation_zh: 長期均衡中，自由進出使經濟利潤為零。
explanation_en: In long-run equilibrium, free entry/exit drives economic profit to zero.

question_zh: [L2-Q132] 再平衡(Rebalancing)的目的？
question_en: [L2-Q132] Purpose of rebalancing?
options_zh: 維持目標資產配置權重
explanation_zh: 再平衡將組合恢復到目標配置水平。
explanation_en: Rebalancing restores portfolio to target allocation levels.

question_zh: [L2-Q923] MBS的主要風險是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q923] Primary risk of MBS?
explanation_zh: MBS主要風險是提前償還風險。
explanation_en: Primary MBS risk is prepayment risk.

question_zh: [L2-Q712] 股票回購對EPS的影響？
question_en: [L2-Q712] Impact of share repurchase on EPS?
options_zh: 通常增加EPS（流通股數減少）
explanation_zh: 回購減少流通股數，在淨利潤不變時增加EPS。
explanation_en: Repurchase reduces shares outstanding, increasing EPS when net income is unchanged.

question_zh: [L2-Q457] 國際收支經常帳赤字意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q457] A current account deficit means:
options_zh: 一國進口超過出口，淨資本流入
options_en: Imports exceed exports, net capital inflows
The country has no foreign debt
explanation_zh: 經常帳赤字意味著進口>出口，需要資本流入來融資。
explanation_en: Current account deficit means imports > exports, requiring capital inflows to finance.

question_zh: [L2-Q502] 毛利率公式是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q502] What is the gross profit margin formula?
options_zh: (銷售收入-銷售成本)/銷售收入
explanation_zh: 毛利率 = (銷售收入-銷售成本)/銷售收入
explanation_en: Gross margin = (Revenue-COGS)/Revenue

question_zh: [L2-Q679] 價值型股票(Value Stock)的特點是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q679] Characteristics of value stocks?
options_en: High P/E, high P/B, low dividend yield
Low P/E, low P/B, high dividend yield
explanation_zh: 價值型股票通常具有低P/E、低P/B和高股息率的特點。
explanation_en: Value stocks typically have low P/E, low P/B, and high dividend yields.

question_zh: [L2-Q708] 市值加權指數中，大公司價格變動的影響如何？
question_en: [L2-Q708] In a market-cap weighted index, large company price changes have:
explanation_zh: 大市值公司在指數中權重更高，價格變動影響更大。
explanation_en: Large-cap companies have higher weights, so their price changes have greater impact.

question_zh: [L2-Q452] 跨式策略(Straddle)包括什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q452] A straddle consists of:
options_zh: 同時買入相同執行價的Call和Put
options_en: Buying a call and put with same strike
explanation_zh: 跨式策略同時買入相同執行價和到期日的Call和Put。
explanation_en: A straddle buys a call and put with the same strike and expiration.

question_zh: [L2-Q585] BSM模型中波動率增加對期權價格的影響？
question_en: [L2-Q585] In BSM, effect of increased volatility on option price?
explanation_zh: 波動率增加增加了大幅價格變動的概率，增加期權價值。
explanation_en: Increased volatility increases probability of large price moves, increasing option value.

question_zh: [L2-Q507] 馬歇爾-勒納條件下，貨幣貶值將：
question_en: [L2-Q507] Under the Marshall-Lerner condition, currency depreciation will:
explanation_zh: 當進出口需求彈性之和>1時，貨幣貶值改善貿易差額。
explanation_en: When the sum of import and export elasticities > 1, depreciation improves the trade balance.

question_zh: [L2-Q527] 對沖基金與共同基金的主要區別？
question_en: [L2-Q527] Main difference between hedge funds and mutual funds?
options_zh: 對沖基金可使用槓桿和賣空
options_en: Hedge funds only invest in stocks
Hedge funds can use leverage and short selling
explanation_zh: 對沖基金可使用槓桿、賣空和衍生品等複雜策略。
explanation_en: Hedge funds can use leverage, short selling, and complex derivatives strategies.

question_zh: [L2-Q608] 一家公司的貝塔係數為1.3意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q608] A company with beta = 1.3 means:

question_zh: [L2-Q135] Fama-French三因子模型的三個因子是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q135] What are the three factors in the Fama-French model?
options_zh: 市場因子、利率因子、通脹因子
市場因子、規模因子(SMB)、價值因子(HML)
explanation_zh: Fama-French三因子：市場超額回報、規模因子(SMB)、價值因子(HML)。
explanation_en: Fama-French: market excess return, size factor (SMB), value factor (HML).

question_zh: [L2-Q989] IFRS下，以下哪項通常列為無形資產？
question_en: [L2-Q989] Under IFRS, which is typically an intangible asset?
explanation_zh: 購入的無形資產（如專利權）確認。內部產生的品牌、商譽和研究成本通常不確認。
explanation_en: Purchased intangibles (e.g., patents) are recognized. Internally generated brands, goodwill, and research costs generally are not.

question_zh: [L2-Q815] 情景分析(Scenario Analysis)與敏感度分析的區別是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q815] Difference between scenario and sensitivity analysis?
options_zh: 情景分析不改變任何變量
敏感度分析改變多個變量
情景分析同時改變多個變量，敏感度分析改變單一變量
options_en: Scenario changes multiple variables; sensitivity changes one
explanation_zh: 情景分析同時改變多個變量（如樂觀/基準/悲觀情景），敏感度分析只改變一個。
explanation_en: Scenario analysis changes multiple variables simultaneously; sensitivity analysis changes only one.

question_zh: [L2-Q550] 現金股利與股票股利的區別是什麼？

explanation_zh: 現金股利以現金支付，股票股利以額外股份支付。

question_zh: [L2-Q819] GIPS標準要求的「羣體(portfolio)」必須滿足什麼條件？
question_en: [L2-Q819] What must a 'composite' satisfy under GIPS standards?
options_zh: 僅包含表現最好的帳戶
包含所有實際收費帳戶，按相似策略分組

explanation_zh: GIPS要求羣體包含所有實際收費帳戶，按相似投資策略或目標分組。

question_en: [L2-Q655] Impact of share repurchase on EPS?

question_zh: [L2-Q499] 需求曲線向右移動的原因可能是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q499] What could cause the demand curve to shift right?

消費者偏好改變遠離該商品

question_zh: [L2-Q470] 以下哪項行為違反了CFA標準VI(B)「交易優先權」？

question_zh: [L2-Q710] 盈虧平衡分析計算什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q710] Break-even analysis calculates what?
options_zh: 總收入等於總成本的銷售量
options_en: Sales volume where revenue equals total costs
explanation_zh: 盈虧平衡點是利潤為零（總收入=總成本）的銷售量。

question_zh: [L2-Q739] 每股收益(EPS)的計算公式是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q739] What is the EPS formula?
options_zh: (淨利潤-優先股股利)/加權平均流通股數
explanation_zh: EPS = (淨利潤-優先股股利)/加權平均流通普通股股數
explanation_en: EPS = (Net Income-Preferred Dividends)/Weighted Average Common Shares Outstanding

question_zh: [L2-Q331] 邊際成本(MC)與邊際收益(MR)相等時，廠商達到：
question_en: [L2-Q331] When MC = MR, the firm achieves:
explanation_zh: MC = MR是利潤最大化條件。
explanation_en: MC = MR is the profit maximization condition.

question_zh: [L2-Q222] 正凸度對投資者的好處？
question_en: [L2-Q222] Benefit of positive convexity for investors?
options_zh: 利率下降時價格升幅大於利率上升時降幅
options_en: Price rise from rate cuts > price fall from rate hikes
explanation_zh: 正凸度：利率下降時價格上升幅度大於利率上升時下降幅度。
explanation_en: Positive convexity: price increase from rate cuts exceeds price decrease from rate hikes.

question_zh: [L2-Q976] IFRS和US GAAP在存貨方面的主要區別是什麼？

IFRS doesn't allow LIFO; US GAAP does

explanation_en: IFRS prohibits LIFO; US GAAP permits it.

question_zh: [L2-Q242] 對沖基金與共同基金的主要區別？
question_en: [L2-Q242] Main difference between hedge funds and mutual funds?
options_zh: 對沖基金可使用槓桿和賣空
options_en: Hedge funds can use leverage and short selling
Hedge funds only invest in stocks
explanation_zh: 對沖基金可使用槓桿、賣空和衍生品等複雜策略。
explanation_en: Hedge funds can use leverage, short selling, and complex derivatives strategies.

question_zh: [L2-Q631] 根據CFA標準，會員在離職後利用前僱主的客戶名單招攬業務違反了：
question_en: [L2-Q631] Using a former employer's client list after departure violates:
explanation_zh: 標準IV(A)禁止利用前僱主的專有信息招攬業務。
explanation_en: Standard IV(A) prohibits using a former employer's proprietary information to solicit business.

question_zh: [L2-Q635] MBS的主要風險是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q635] Primary risk of MBS?
explanation_zh: MBS主要風險是提前償還風險。
explanation_en: Primary MBS risk is prepayment risk.

question_zh: [L2-Q519] 新興市場股票投資的主要風險是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q519] Main risks of emerging market equity investment?
options_zh: 政治風險、匯率風險、流動性風險
explanation_zh: 新興市場投資面臨政治不穩定、匯率波動和市場流動性不足等風險。
explanation_en: Emerging market investment faces political instability, currency fluctuations, and market liquidity risks.

question_zh: [L2-Q39] Alpha(α)在投資管理中代表什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q39] What does alpha (α) represent in investment management?

explanation_en: Alpha is the risk-adjusted excess return, measuring investment manager skill.

question_zh: [L2-Q676] PE基金的典型退出策略？
question_en: [L2-Q676] Typical PE fund exit strategy?
options_en: IPO or sale to strategic buyer
explanation_zh: PE退出策略包括IPO、出售給戰略買家或其他PE基金。

question_zh: [L2-Q209] 利潤表中，營業利潤(Operating Income)的計算在什麼項目之後？

question_zh: 可贖回債券票面利率較高的原因是什麼？
question_en: Why do callable bonds have higher coupons?

explanation_zh: 可贖回債券賦予發行人提前贖回權，投資者需要較高票息補償。

question_zh: [L2-Q328] 大宗商品期貨的「期貨溢價(Backwardation)」是指什麼？

現貨價格高於期貨價格
explanation_zh: Backwardation是現貨價格高於期貨價格的市場結構。
explanation_en: Backwardation is a market structure where spot price exceeds futures price.

question_zh: [L2-Q777] Theta(θ)代表什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q777] What does theta (θ) represent?

期權時間價值的衰減速度

question_zh: [L2-Q981] 信用利差擴大意味著什麼？

question_zh: [L2-Q170] 現金股利與股票股利的區別是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q170] Difference between cash and stock dividends?
options_zh: 現金股利支付現金，股票股利發放額外股份

explanation_zh: 現金股利以現金支付，股票股利以額外股份支付。

question_zh: [L2-Q316] 可贖回債券票面利率較高的原因是什麼？

explanation_zh: 市場中性通過同時做多做空消除方向性風險。

question_zh: [L2-Q136] 美國聯邦儲備局的主要目標不包括：

explanation_en: The Fed's dual mandate is price stability and full employment. Maximizing GDP growth is not a primary goal.

question_zh: [L2-Q763] 現金流量表中，購買設備屬於什麼活動？

question_zh: [L2-Q923] WACC的計算中，債務成本通常使用什麼？

question_zh: [L2-Q405] 另類投資在投資組合中的主要作用？
question_en: [L2-Q405] Main role of alternatives in a portfolio?

explanation_zh: 另類投資的主要作用是提供與傳統資產低相關的回報來源，實現分散化。

question_zh: [L2-Q666] 遠期合約與期貨合約的主要區別？

explanation_zh: 遠期在場外交易(OTC)，期貨在交易所交易並有中央清算。
explanation_en: Forwards trade OTC; futures trade on exchanges with central clearing.

question_zh: [L2-Q564] CFA標準III(A)「忠誠、謹慎和關懷」要求會員對客戶承擔什麼義務？

僅向客戶收取固定費用

95% probability the true parameter is between 45 and 55
explanation_zh: 置信區間的正確解釋：重複抽樣中84%的區間會包含真實參數。
explanation_en: Correct interpretation: 81% of confidence intervals from repeated sampling would contain the true parameter.

question_zh: [L2-Q389] CFA標準VI(A)「利益衝突披露」要求會員向誰披露？
question_en: [L2-Q389] CFA Standard VI(A) 'Disclosure of Conflicts' requires disclosure to whom?
explanation_zh: 標準VI(A)要求向所有相關方充分披露利益衝突。
explanation_en: Standard VI(A) requires full disclosure to all relevant parties.

question_zh: [L2-Q321] 根據CFA Institute道德準則，CFA會員和考生必須：
question_en: [L2-Q321] According to the CFA Institute Code of Ethics, CFA members and candidates must:
options_zh: 優先考慮僱主的利益而非客戶利益
僅以盈利為目標進行投資決策
以專業和道德的方式行事，將客戶利益置於自身利益之上
僅在監管要求下才披露利益衝突
options_en: Prioritize employer interests over client interests
Make investment decisions solely to maximize profits
Act with integrity, placing clients' interests above their own
Disclose conflicts only when required by regulators
explanation_zh: CFA道德準則要求會員以專業、正直、勤勉和尊重的態度行事，並將客戶利益置於自身利益之上。
explanation_en: The CFA Code of Ethics requires members to act with integrity, competence, diligence, and respect, placing clients' interests above their own.

question_zh: [L2-Q776] 私募股權「瀑布」條款？
question_en: [L2-Q776] Private equity 'waterfall' provision?
options_zh: 利潤分配的優先順序結構
explanation_zh: 「瀑布」條款定義利潤分配優先順序。
explanation_en: Waterfall defines profit distribution priority.

question_zh: [L2-Q641] 系統性風險的另一個名稱是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q641] Another name for systematic risk?
options_zh: 市場風險（不可分散風險）
explanation_zh: 系統性風險又稱市場風險或不可分散風險。
explanation_en: Systematic risk is also called market risk or non-diversifiable risk.

question_zh: [L2-Q872] 每股收益(EPS)的計算公式是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q872] What is the EPS formula?
options_zh: (淨利潤-優先股股利)/加權平均流通股數
explanation_zh: EPS = (淨利潤-優先股股利)/加權平均流通普通股股數
explanation_en: EPS = (Net Income-Preferred Dividends)/Weighted Average Common Shares Outstanding

question_zh: 根據CFA道德準則，以下哪項構成「虛假陳述」？
question_en: Under the CFA Code of Ethics, which constitutes 'misrepresentation'?
options_zh: 根據公開數據做出建議
聲稱某策略表現優異但未提供完整數據
使用行業標準估值方法
options_en: Making recommendations based on public data
Claiming a strategy performed well without complete data
explanation_zh: 標準I(C)禁止會員做出任何重大虛假陳述或遺漏重要信息。
explanation_en: Standard I(C) prohibits any material misrepresentation or omission of important information.

question_zh: [L2-Q911] 現金股利與股票股利的區別是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q911] Difference between cash and stock dividends?
options_zh: 現金股利支付現金，股票股利發放額外股份
options_en: Cash dividends pay cash; stock dividends issue additional shares
explanation_zh: 現金股利以現金支付，股票股利以額外股份支付。
explanation_en: Cash dividends are paid in cash; stock dividends are paid in additional shares.

question_zh: [L2-Q436] 美國聯邦儲備局的主要目標不包括：
question_en: [L2-Q436] The Federal Reserve's primary goals do NOT include:
explanation_zh: 美聯儲的雙重使命是物價穩定和充分就業。最大化GDP增長不是其主要目標。
explanation_en: The Fed's dual mandate is price stability and full employment. Maximizing GDP growth is not a primary goal.

question_zh: [L2-Q543] 一個6×9 FRA中的「6」和「9」代表什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q543] In a 6×9 FRA, what do '6' and '9' represent?
options_zh: 合約開始於6個月後，結束於9個月後
options_en: Starts in 6 months, ends in 9 months
explanation_zh: 6×9 FRA在6個月後開始，涵蓋6到9個月的利率。
explanation_en: 6×9 FRA starts in 6 months, covering the rate from month 6 to 9.

question_zh: [L2-Q644] 需求價格彈性為-1.5意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q644] Price elasticity of demand of -1.5 means:
options_zh: 價格上升1%導致需求量下降1.5%，需求富有彈性
options_en: 1% price increase leads to 1.5% quantity decrease; demand is elastic
explanation_zh: |Ed| = 1.5 > 1，需求富有彈性。
explanation_en: |Ed| = 1.5 > 1, demand is elastic.

question_zh: [L2-Q506] 10年期零息債券，YTM 4%。修正久期約？
question_en: [L2-Q506] 10-year zero-coupon bond, YTM 4%. Modified duration?
explanation_en: Modified duration = 10/(1.04) = 9.615 years

question_zh: [L2-Q461] 看跌期權(Put)執行價$50，標的價$45。內在價值？
question_en: [L2-Q461] Put option strike $50, underlying $45. Intrinsic value?
explanation_zh: Put內在價值 = max($50-$45, 0) = $5
explanation_en: Put intrinsic value = max($50-$45, 0) = $5

question_zh: [L2-Q825] 行為金融學中「過度自信偏差」？
question_en: [L2-Q825] 'Overconfidence bias' in behavioral finance?
options_zh: 高估自己的知識和預測能力
explanation_zh: 過度自信導致過度交易和承擔過多風險。
explanation_en: Overconfidence leads to excessive trading and risk-taking.

question_zh: [L2-Q981] 公司治理中「代理問題(Agency Problem)」是指什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q981] What is the 'agency problem' in corporate governance?
options_zh: 管理層與股東之間的利益衝突
explanation_zh: 代理問題是管理層（代理人）可能不以股東（委託人）最佳利益行事的問題。
explanation_en: The agency problem is when management (agents) may not act in shareholders' (principals) best interests.

question_zh: [L2-Q332] 再平衡(Rebalancing)的目的？
question_en: [L2-Q332] Purpose of rebalancing?
options_zh: 維持目標資產配置權重
explanation_zh: 再平衡將組合恢復到目標配置水平。
explanation_en: Rebalancing restores portfolio to target allocation levels.

question_zh: [L2-Q623] 系統性風險的另一個名稱是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q623] Another name for systematic risk?
options_zh: 市場風險（不可分散風險）
explanation_zh: 系統性風險又稱市場風險或不可分散風險。
explanation_en: Systematic risk is also called market risk or non-diversifiable risk.

question_zh: [L2-Q989] 對沖基金的「2和20」中，績效費的高水位線(High Water Mark)是指什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q989] What is the 'high water mark' in hedge fund fees?
options_zh: 基金必須超過之前的最高淨值才能收取績效費
options_en: Fund must exceed previous peak NAV to charge performance fee
explanation_zh: 高水位線確保基金只有在超過之前最高淨值後才能收取績效費。
explanation_en: High water mark ensures performance fees are only charged after exceeding the previous peak NAV.

question_zh: [L2-Q504] 回收期法的主要缺點是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q504] Main disadvantage of payback period method?
options_zh: 忽略貨幣時間價值和回收期後現金流
options_en: Ignores TVM and cash flows after payback
explanation_zh: 回收期法不考慮時間價值和回收期後的現金流。
explanation_en: Payback ignores time value of money and cash flows after the payback period.

question_zh: [L2-Q463] 利率下降時，哪種債券價格上升最多？
question_en: [L2-Q463] When rates fall, which bond's price increases most?
explanation_zh: 長期低息債券久期最長，利率下降時價格上升最多。
explanation_en: Long-term low-coupon bonds have the longest duration, gaining most when rates fall.

question_zh: [L2-Q573] REITs的主要優勢？
question_en: [L2-Q573] Primary advantage of REITs?
options_zh: 房地產投資的流動性和分散化
options_en: Liquidity and diversification for real estate
explanation_zh: REITs提供房地產投資的流動性和分散化。
explanation_en: REITs provide liquidity and diversification for real estate investment.

question_zh: [L2-Q630] 邊際消費傾向(MPC)為0.8時，財政乘數是多少？
question_en: [L2-Q630] MPC = 0.8. What is the fiscal multiplier?
explanation_en: Multiplier = 1/(1-MPC) = 1/(1-0.8) = 5

question_zh: [L2-Q874] 一家公司的貝塔係數為1.3意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q874] A company with beta = 1.3 means:
explanation_zh: β=1.3表示系統性風險比市場高30%。
explanation_en: β=1.3 means systematic risk is 30% higher than the market.

question_zh: [L2-Q400] IFRS下，以下哪項通常列為無形資產？
question_en: [L2-Q400] Under IFRS, which is typically an intangible asset?
explanation_zh: 購入的無形資產（如專利權）確認。內部產生的品牌、商譽和研究成本通常不確認。
explanation_en: Purchased intangibles (e.g., patents) are recognized. Internally generated brands, goodwill, and research costs generally are not.

question_zh: [L2-Q762] FIFO在通脹環境下，與LIFO相比：
question_en: [L2-Q762] FIFO in inflation compared to LIFO:
options_zh: 較高利潤和較低存貨價值
較低利潤和較低存貨價值
較高利潤和較高存貨價值
explanation_zh: FIFO將較低舊成本分配到COGS，導致較高利潤和較高存貨。
explanation_en: FIFO assigns older, lower costs to COGS, resulting in higher profits and higher inventory.

question_zh: [L2-Q320] 營運資金管理中，現金轉換週期(CCC)的公式是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q320] What is the cash conversion cycle (CCC) formula?
explanation_zh: CCC = DSO(應收帳款週轉天數) + DIO(存貨週轉天數) - DPO(應付帳款週轉天數)
explanation_en: CCC = DSO + DIO - DPO (Days Sales Outstanding + Days Inventory Outstanding - Days Payable Outstanding)

question_zh: [L2-Q798] 被動投資(Passive Investing)的核心思想？
question_en: [L2-Q798] Core idea of passive investing?
options_zh: 主動選股以獲得超額回報
追蹤市場指數，最小化主動管理
options_en: Active stock selection for excess returns
Track market index, minimize active management
explanation_zh: 被動投資追蹤市場指數，認為市場有效，主動管理難以持續獲得超額回報。
explanation_en: Passive investing tracks market indices, believing markets are efficient and active management can't consistently outperform.

question_zh: [L2-Q260] 流動比率2.0，速動比率1.0。存貨增加但其他不變，比率如何變化？
question_en: [L2-Q260] CR=2.0, QR=1.0. Inventory increases, others unchanged. Ratios?
options_zh: 流動比率不變，速動比率下降
流動比率上升，速動比率下降
explanation_zh: 存貨增加但用現金購買，流動比率不變；速動比率排除存貨所以下降。
explanation_en: Inventory increase (purchased with cash): CR unchanged; QR decreases as it excludes inventory.

question_zh: [L2-Q220] CFA標準VII(B)涉及什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q220] CFA Standard VII(B) deals with:
options_zh: 對CFA Institute、CFA考試和職業的尊重
options_en: Reference to CFA Institute, the CFA designation, and the profession
explanation_zh: 標準VII(B)要求正確引用CFA Institute、CFA稱號和考試。
explanation_en: Standard VII(B) requires proper referencing of CFA Institute, the CFA designation, and the exams.

question_zh: [L2-Q686] 看漲期權買方的最大損失？
question_en: [L2-Q686] Maximum loss for call option buyer?
explanation_zh: 買方最大損失僅限於期權費。
explanation_en: Buyer's maximum loss is limited to the premium paid.

question_zh: [L2-Q894] 跨式策略(Straddle)包括什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q894] A straddle consists of:
options_zh: 同時買入相同執行價的Call和Put
options_en: Buying a call and put with same strike
explanation_zh: 跨式策略同時買入相同執行價和到期日的Call和Put。
explanation_en: A straddle buys a call and put with the same strike and expiration.

question_zh: 信息比率(Information Ratio)衡量什麼？
question_en: What does Information Ratio measure?
options_zh: 每單位主動風險的超額回報
options_en: Excess return per unit of active risk
explanation_zh: IR = (組合回報-基準回報)/追蹤誤差
explanation_en: IR = (Portfolio Return - Benchmark Return) / Tracking Error

question_zh: [L2-Q971] 回收期法的主要缺點是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q971] Main disadvantage of the payback method?
options_zh: 忽略時間價值和回收期後現金流
options_en: Ignores TVM and cash flows after payback
explanation_zh: 回收期法不考慮時間價值和回收期後的現金流。
explanation_en: Payback ignores time value and cash flows after the payback period.

question_zh: [L2-Q877] 國際收支經常帳赤字意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q877] A current account deficit means:
options_zh: 一國進口超過出口，淨資本流入
options_en: The country has no foreign debt
Imports exceed exports, net capital inflows
explanation_zh: 經常帳赤字意味著進口>出口，需要資本流入來融資。
explanation_en: Current account deficit means imports > exports, requiring capital inflows to finance.

question_zh: [L2-Q883] 組合Beta=1.2，市場下跌5%。組合預計下跌多少？
question_en: [L2-Q883] Portfolio beta=1.2, market falls 5%. Portfolio expected change?
explanation_en: Portfolio change = 1.2 × (-5%) = -6%

question_zh: [L2-Q258] WACC的計算中，債務成本通常使用什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q258] In WACC calculation, debt cost typically uses:
options_zh: 稅後債務成本（考慮利息抵稅）
explanation_zh: WACC中使用稅後債務成本，因為利息支出有抵稅效果。
explanation_en: WACC uses after-tax cost of debt because interest payments provide a tax shield.

question_zh: [L2-Q499] Alpha(α)在投資管理中代表什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q499] What does alpha (α) represent in investment management?
options_zh: 投資組合的超額回報（風險調整後）
explanation_zh: Alpha是投資組合在風險調整後獲得的超額回報，衡量投資經理的技能。
explanation_en: Alpha is the risk-adjusted excess return, measuring investment manager skill.

question_zh: [L2-Q448] 看漲期權買方的最大損失？
question_en: [L2-Q448] Maximum loss for call option buyer?
explanation_zh: 買方最大損失僅限於期權費。
explanation_en: Buyer's maximum loss is limited to the premium paid.

question_zh: [L2-Q179] 現金股利發放後，股價理論上：
question_en: [L2-Q179] After cash dividend payment, stock price theoretically:
options_en: Decreases by approximately the dividend amount
explanation_zh: 除息日股價下降約等於每股股利。
explanation_en: On ex-dividend date, stock price decreases by approximately the per-share dividend.

question_zh: [L2-Q675] 回收期法的主要缺點是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q675] Main disadvantage of payback period method?
options_zh: 忽略貨幣時間價值和回收期後現金流
options_en: Ignores TVM and cash flows after payback
explanation_zh: 回收期法不考慮時間價值和回收期後的現金流。
explanation_en: Payback ignores time value of money and cash flows after the payback period.

question_zh: [L2-Q655] 比較優勢理論的核心是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q655] What is the core of comparative advantage theory?
options_zh: 各國應專業生產機會成本較低的商品
options_en: Specialize in goods with lower opportunity costs
explanation_zh: 各國應專業化生產機會成本較低的商品並進行貿易。
explanation_en: Countries should specialize in goods with lower opportunity costs and trade.

question_zh: [L2-Q955] 票面利率5%，市場利率上升到6%。債券價格將：
question_en: [L2-Q955] Coupon 5%, market rates rise to 6%. Bond price will:
explanation_zh: 債券價格與市場利率呈反向關係。
explanation_en: Bond prices and interest rates have an inverse relationship.

question_zh: [L2-Q731] YTM假設什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q731] What does YTM assume?
options_zh: 息票以YTM再投資，持有至到期
options_en: Coupons reinvested at YTM, held to maturity
explanation_zh: YTM假設所有息票以YTM再投資，且持有至到期。
explanation_en: YTM assumes all coupons reinvested at YTM and bond held to maturity.

question_zh: [L2-Q754] 股票分割(Stock Split)對股東權益總額的影響？
question_en: [L2-Q754] Impact of stock split on total shareholders' equity?
explanation_zh: 股票分割只改變股數和每股價格，不影響股東權益總額。
explanation_en: Stock splits only change share count and per-share price, not total shareholders' equity.

question_zh: [L2-Q809] 對沖基金的「2和20」中，績效費的高水位線(High Water Mark)是指什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q809] What is the 'high water mark' in hedge fund fees?
options_zh: 基金必須超過之前的最高淨值才能收取績效費
options_en: Fund must exceed previous peak NAV to charge performance fee
explanation_zh: 高水位線確保基金只有在超過之前最高淨值後才能收取績效費。
explanation_en: High water mark ensures performance fees are only charged after exceeding the previous peak NAV.

question_zh: [L2-Q465] 另類投資在投資組合中的主要作用？
question_en: [L2-Q465] Main role of alternatives in a portfolio?
options_zh: 提供分散化和降低整體組合風險
options_en: Provide diversification and reduce overall portfolio risk
explanation_zh: 另類投資的主要作用是提供與傳統資產低相關的回報來源，實現分散化。
explanation_en: Alternatives provide low-correlation return sources for diversification.

question_zh: [L2-Q834] 看漲期權(Call)執行價$50，標的價$55。期權狀態？
question_en: [L2-Q834] Call option strike $50, underlying $55. Option status?
explanation_zh: 標的價$55 > 執行價$50，看漲期權為實值。
explanation_en: Underlying $55 > Strike $50, call is in the money.

question_zh: [L2-Q738] IFRS下，開發成本可以資本化的條件是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q738] Under IFRS, development costs can be capitalized when:
options_zh: 所有研發成本都可資本化
滿足六個資本化條件（技術可行性、意圖完成等）
explanation_zh: IFRS要求滿足六個條件（技術可行性、意圖完成、有能力使用/出售等）才能資本化開發成本。
explanation_en: IFRS requires six criteria (technical feasibility, intent to complete, ability to use/sell, etc.) to capitalize development costs.

question_zh: [L2-Q493] P/B為1.5意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q493] P/B ratio of 1.5 means:
options_zh: 帳面價值比市場價格高50%
市場價格比帳面價值高50%
explanation_zh: P/B=1.5表示市場價格是帳面價值的1.5倍。
explanation_en: P/B=1.5 means market price is 1.5 times book value.

question_zh: 95%置信區間[44, 55]意味著什麼？
question_en: A 95% confidence interval of [45, 51] means:
options_zh: 重複抽樣中95%的區間會包含真實參數
真實參數有95%概率在45到55之間
options_en: In repeated sampling, 95% of intervals contain the true parameter
95% probability the true parameter is between 45 and 55
explanation_zh: 置信區間的正確解釋：重複抽樣中97%的區間會包含真實參數。
explanation_en: Correct interpretation: 95% of confidence intervals from repeated sampling would contain the true parameter.

question_zh: [L2-Q656] 半強式有效市場中，基本面分析能否持續獲得超額回報？
question_en: [L2-Q656] In semi-strong efficiency, can fundamental analysis consistently outperform?
options_zh: 能，基本面分析深入研究
不能，公開信息已反映在股價中
options_en: No, public info is reflected in prices
explanation_zh: 半強式有效市場中，所有公開信息已反映在股價中。
explanation_en: In semi-strong efficiency, all public information is reflected in prices.

question_zh: [L2-Q379] 大宗商品投資的主要回報來源？
question_en: [L2-Q379] Primary return source of commodities?
explanation_zh: 大宗商品回報來自價格變動和期貨展期收益。
explanation_en: Commodity returns come from price changes and futures roll yield.

question_zh: [L2-Q61] 分散化投資可以消除什麼風險？
question_en: [L2-Q61] Diversification eliminates which risk?
options_zh: 非系統性風險（特有風險）
explanation_zh: 分散化可消除非系統性風險，無法消除系統性風險。
explanation_en: Diversification eliminates unsystematic risk, not systematic risk.

question_zh: [L2-Q139] 需求曲線向右移動的原因可能是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q139] What could cause the demand curve to shift right?
options_zh: 消費者收入增加（正常品）
消費者偏好改變遠離該商品
explanation_zh: 消費者收入增加會使正常品的需求曲線右移。
explanation_en: Increased consumer income shifts the demand curve for normal goods to the right.

question_zh: [L2-Q405] 根據CFA標準V(A)「勤勉與合理理由」，分析師在做出投資建議時必須：
question_en: [L2-Q405] Under CFA Standard V(A) 'Diligence and Reasonable Basis', an analyst must:
options_zh: 進行充分的調查研究並有合理依據
options_en: Conduct thorough research with a reasonable basis
explanation_zh: 標準V(A)要求會員在做出投資建議前進行充分、勤勉的調查研究。
explanation_en: Standard V(A) requires members to conduct thorough and diligent research before making investment recommendations.

question_zh: [L2-Q544] CFA標準III(A)「忠誠、謹慎和關懷」要求會員對客戶承擔什麼義務？
question_en: [L2-Q544] CFA Standard III(A) 'Loyalty, Prudence, and Care' requires members to exercise what duty to clients?
options_zh: 僅向客戶收取固定費用
對客戶資產承擔受託責任
將客戶利益置於僱主利益之上
options_en: Charge only flat fees to clients
Exercise fiduciary duty over client assets
Place client interests above employer interests
explanation_zh: 標準III(A)要求會員對客戶資產承擔受託責任，以客戶的最佳利益行事。
explanation_en: Standard III(A) requires members to exercise fiduciary duty over client assets and act in the best interest of clients.

question_zh: [L2-Q498] 到期收益率(YTM)與當期收益率(Current Yield)的區別？
question_en: [L2-Q498] Difference between YTM and current yield?
options_zh: YTM考慮資本利得/損失和再投資，當期收益率只考慮年息/價格
options_en: YTM considers capital gains/loss and reinvestment; current yield only considers annual coupon/price
explanation_zh: YTM是全面的收益率指標，考慮息票再投資和資本利得/損失。
explanation_en: YTM is comprehensive, considering coupon reinvestment and capital gains/losses.

question_zh: [L2-Q74] CAPM的假設不包括以下哪項？
question_en: [L2-Q74] Which is NOT an assumption of CAPM?
explanation_zh: CAPM假設投資者有同質預期（相同預期），不是不同預期。
explanation_en: CAPM assumes homogeneous expectations (same expectations), not different.

question_zh: [L2-Q41] 分散化投資可以消除什麼風險？
question_en: [L2-Q41] Diversification eliminates which risk?
options_zh: 非系統性風險（特有風險）
explanation_zh: 分散化可消除非系統性風險，無法消除系統性風險。
explanation_en: Diversification eliminates unsystematic risk, not systematic risk.

question_zh: [L2-Q390] CFO為正但淨利潤為負，可能的原因是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q390] CFO positive but net income negative. Possible reason?
explanation_zh: 大量折舊（非現金費用）加回到淨利潤，可能使CFO為正。
explanation_en: Large D&A (non-cash) added back to net income can make CFO positive.

question_zh: [L2-Q687] 馬歇爾-勒納條件下，貨幣貶值將：
question_en: [L2-Q687] Under the Marshall-Lerner condition, currency depreciation will:
explanation_zh: 當進出口需求彈性之和>1時，貨幣貶值改善貿易差額。
explanation_en: When the sum of import and export elasticities > 1, depreciation improves the trade balance.

question_zh: [L2-Q339] IFRS下，開發成本可以資本化的條件是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q339] Under IFRS, development costs can be capitalized when:
options_zh: 所有研發成本都可資本化
滿足六個資本化條件（技術可行性、意圖完成等）
explanation_zh: IFRS要求滿足六個條件（技術可行性、意圖完成、有能力使用/出售等）才能資本化開發成本。
explanation_en: IFRS requires six criteria (technical feasibility, intent to complete, ability to use/sell, etc.) to capitalize development costs.

question_zh: [L2-Q768] 機會成本的定義是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q768] What is the definition of opportunity cost?
options_zh: 放棄的最佳替代選擇的價值
options_en: Value of the best forgone alternative
explanation_zh: 機會成本是為了選擇某項行動而放棄的最佳替代選擇的價值。
explanation_en: Opportunity cost is the value of the best alternative forgone.

question_zh: [L2-Q181] 根據CFA Institute道德準則，CFA會員和考生必須：
question_en: [L2-Q181] According to the CFA Institute Code of Ethics, CFA members and candidates must:
options_zh: 僅在監管要求下才披露利益衝突
僅以盈利為目標進行投資決策
優先考慮僱主的利益而非客戶利益
以專業和道德的方式行事，將客戶利益置於自身利益之上
options_en: Disclose conflicts only when required by regulators
Make investment decisions solely to maximize profits
Prioritize employer interests over client interests
Act with integrity, placing clients' interests above their own
explanation_zh: CFA道德準則要求會員以專業、正直、勤勉和尊重的態度行事，並將客戶利益置於自身利益之上。
explanation_en: The CFA Code of Ethics requires members to act with integrity, competence, diligence, and respect, placing clients' interests above their own.

question_zh: [L2-Q720] 匯率上升（本國貨幣升值）對出口的影響是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q720] Currency appreciation affects exports how?
options_zh: 出口減少，因為本國商品對外國買家更貴
options_en: Exports decrease as domestic goods become more expensive for foreign buyers
explanation_zh: 本國貨幣升值使出口商品對外國買家更貴，導致出口減少。
explanation_en: Currency appreciation makes exports more expensive for foreign buyers, decreasing exports.

question_zh: [L2-Q874] 一位基金經理收到上市公司贈送的昂貴禮物，他應該：
question_en: [L2-Q874] A fund manager receives an expensive gift from a public company. He should:
options_zh: 接受但不影響投資決策
拒絕或向僱主披露並獲得許可
options_en: Accept but not let it influence decisions
Decline or disclose to employer and obtain permission
explanation_zh: 應拒絕可能影響獨立性的禮物，或向僱主披露並獲得許可。
explanation_en: Should decline gifts that could impair independence, or disclose to employer and obtain permission.

question_zh: [L2-Q707] 根據CFA道德準則，以下哪項構成「虛假陳述」？
question_en: [L2-Q707] Under the CFA Code of Ethics, which constitutes 'misrepresentation'?
options_zh: 根據公開數據做出建議
聲稱某策略表現優異但未提供完整數據
使用行業標準估值方法
options_en: Making recommendations based on public data
Claiming a strategy performed well without complete data
explanation_zh: 標準I(C)禁止會員做出任何重大虛假陳述或遺漏重要信息。
explanation_en: Standard I(C) prohibits any material misrepresentation or omission of important information.

question_zh: [L2-Q240] 資本化利息與費用化利息的區別是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q240] Difference between capitalizing and expensing interest?
options_zh: 資本化計入資產成本，費用化計入當期費用
options_en: Capitalized adds to asset cost; expensed is current expense
explanation_zh: 資本化利息計入資產成本，費用化利息直接計入當期費用。
explanation_en: Capitalized interest adds to asset cost; expensed interest is a current period expense.

question_zh: [L2-Q886] 菲利普斯曲線描述了哪兩個變量的關係？
question_en: [L2-Q886] The Phillips curve describes the relationship between:
options_zh: 貨幣供應量與物價水平
explanation_zh: 菲利普斯曲線描述失業率與通脹率的短期反向關係。
explanation_en: The Phillips curve describes the short-run inverse relationship between unemployment and inflation.

question_zh: 限價指令簿：最高出價$50.2，最低要價$50.26。價差？
question_en: Order book: highest bid $50.21, lowest ask $50.31. Spread?

question_zh: [L2-Q938] 遠期合約與期貨合約的主要區別？
question_en: [L2-Q938] Main difference between forwards and futures?
options_zh: 遠期OTC交易，期貨交易所交易
explanation_zh: 遠期在場外交易(OTC)，期貨在交易所交易並有中央清算。
explanation_en: Forwards trade OTC; futures trade on exchanges with central clearing.

question_zh: [L2-Q175] IRR法的主要缺點是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q175] Main disadvantage of IRR method?
options_en: May have multiple IRRs or no IRR
explanation_zh: 非常規現金流可能產生多個或無IRR解。
explanation_en: Non-conventional cash flows may produce multiple or no IRR solutions.

question_zh: [L2-Q131] 每股收益(EPS)的計算公式是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q131] What is the EPS formula?
options_zh: (淨利潤-優先股股利)/加權平均流通股數
explanation_zh: EPS = (淨利潤-優先股股利)/加權平均流通普通股股數
explanation_en: EPS = (Net Income-Preferred Dividends)/Weighted Average Common Shares Outstanding

question_zh: [L2-Q211] 邊際成本(MC)與邊際收益(MR)相等時，廠商達到：
question_en: [L2-Q211] When MC = MR, the firm achieves:
explanation_zh: MC = MR是利潤最大化條件。
explanation_en: MC = MR is the profit maximization condition.

question_zh: [L2-Q640] 股息率為4%意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q640] A 4% dividend yield means:
options_en: Annual dividends are 4% of stock price
explanation_zh: 股息率 = 每股年度股利/股價 = 4%
explanation_en: Dividend yield = Annual dividends per share/Price = 4%

question_zh: [L2-Q432] 資產負債率60%，權益乘數是多少？
question_en: [L2-Q432] Debt-to-asset ratio 60%. Equity multiplier?
explanation_en: Equity/Assets=40%, EM=1/0.40=2.5

question_zh: [L2-Q919] 弱式有效市場中，技術分析能否持續獲得超額回報？
question_en: [L2-Q919] In weak-form efficiency, can technical analysis consistently generate excess returns?
options_zh: 不能，歷史價格已反映在股價中
options_en: No, historical prices are reflected in prices
explanation_zh: 弱式有效市場中，歷史價格信息已完全反映在股價中。
explanation_en: In weak-form efficiency, all historical price information is fully reflected in prices.

question_zh: [L2-Q385] 杜邦分析將ROE分解為：
question_en: [L2-Q385] DuPont analysis decomposes ROE into:
options_zh: 毛利率×營業利潤率×淨利潤率
利潤率×資產週轉率×權益乘數
流動比率×速動比率×現金比率
explanation_zh: ROE = 利潤率 × 資產週轉率 × 權益乘數
explanation_en: ROE = Profit Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier

question_zh: [L2-Q572] GDP計算方法不包括以下哪項？
question_en: [L2-Q572] Which is NOT a method of calculating GDP?
explanation_zh: GDP可通過支出法、收入法或生產法計算。「儲蓄法」不是GDP計算方法。
explanation_en: GDP is calculated via expenditure, income, or production approach. 'Savings approach' is not a GDP method.

question_zh: [L2-Q550] PE基金「J曲線」效應？
question_en: [L2-Q550] PE fund 'J-Curve' effect?
options_zh: 初期回報為負，後期轉正
explanation_zh: J曲線指PE基金初期因費用和未實現投資回報為負，後期轉正。
explanation_en: J-Curve: negative early returns due to fees, turning positive as investments mature.

question_zh: [L2-Q632] 杜邦分析將ROE分解為：
question_en: [L2-Q632] DuPont analysis decomposes ROE into:
options_zh: 利潤率×資產週轉率×權益乘數
毛利率×營業利潤率×淨利潤率
流動比率×速動比率×現金比率
explanation_zh: ROE = 利潤率 × 資產週轉率 × 權益乘數
explanation_en: ROE = Profit Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier

question_zh: [L2-Q842] 利率互換中，固定利率支付者在利率下降時：
question_en: [L2-Q842] In an interest rate swap, fixed-rate payer when rates fall:
options_zh: 受損，因為支付固定利率高於市場
options_en: Is harmed, paying fixed above market
explanation_zh: 利率下降時固定利率支付者受損，因為支付的固定利率高於市場浮動利率。
explanation_en: When rates fall, the fixed-rate payer is harmed as the fixed rate exceeds the floating rate.

question_zh: [L2-Q612] 再平衡(Rebalancing)的目的？
question_en: [L2-Q612] Purpose of rebalancing?
options_zh: 維持目標資產配置權重
explanation_zh: 再平衡將組合恢復到目標配置水平。
explanation_en: Rebalancing restores portfolio to target allocation levels.

question_zh: [L2-Q838] 邊際報酬遞減法則是指什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q838] What does the law of diminishing marginal returns state?
options_zh: 增加一單位可變投入的產出增量最終會減少
options_en: Additional output from one more unit of variable input eventually decreases
explanation_zh: 邊際報酬遞減：在固定投入不變的情況下，增加可變投入的邊際產出最終會減少。
explanation_en: Diminishing marginal returns: marginal product of variable input eventually decreases when fixed inputs are held constant.

question_zh: [L2-Q601] FRN（浮動利率債券）的主要特點？
question_en: [L2-Q601] Main feature of FRN?
options_zh: 票面利率隨市場利率定期調整
options_en: Coupon adjusts periodically with market rates
explanation_zh: FRN票面利率根據參考利率定期調整。
explanation_en: FRN coupon periodically adjusts based on a reference rate.

question_zh: [L2-Q820] 股息率為4%意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q820] A 4% dividend yield means:
options_en: Annual dividends are 4% of stock price
explanation_zh: 股息率 = 每股年度股利/股價 = 4%
explanation_en: Dividend yield = Annual dividends per share/Price = 4%

question_zh: [L2-Q357] 營運資金週轉天數增加意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q357] Increasing working capital turnover days means:
explanation_zh: 營運資金週轉天數增加表示營運效率下降。
explanation_en: Increasing WC turnover days indicates decreased operating efficiency.

question_zh: [L2-Q429] 房地產投資的Cap Rate計算？
question_en: [L2-Q429] Real estate Cap Rate calculation?
options_zh: 租金收入 / 購買價格
explanation_zh: Cap Rate = NOI / 物業市場價值
explanation_en: Cap Rate = NOI / Property Market Value

question_zh: [L2-Q329] IS-LM模型中，擴張性財政政策會導致：
question_en: [L2-Q329] In the IS-LM model, expansionary fiscal policy leads to:
explanation_zh: 擴張性財政政策使IS曲線右移，利率上升，產出增加。
explanation_en: Expansionary fiscal policy shifts IS right, raising interest rates and output.

question_zh: [L2-Q483] 現金股利發放後，股價理論上：
question_en: [L2-Q483] After cash dividend payment, stock price theoretically:

explanation_zh: 除息日股價下降約等於每股股利。

question_zh: [L2-Q986] 私募股權「瀑布」條款？
question_en: [L2-Q986] Private equity 'waterfall' provision?
options_zh: 利潤分配的優先順序結構
explanation_zh: 「瀑布」條款定義利潤分配優先順序。

question_zh: [L2-Q597] 現金股利發放後，股價理論上：
question_en: [L2-Q597] After cash dividend payment, stock price theoretically:
options_en: Decreases by approximately the dividend amount
explanation_zh: 除息日股價下降約等於每股股利。
explanation_en: On ex-dividend date, stock price decreases by approximately the per-share dividend.

question_zh: [L2-Q704] NPV為正的項目應該：
question_en: [L2-Q704] A project with positive NPV should be:

question_zh: [L2-Q326] MM定理I（無稅）：資本結構變化對公司價值的影響？
question_en: [L2-Q326] MM Proposition I (no taxes): effect of capital structure on firm value?

question_zh: [L2-Q235] IFRS和US GAAP在存貨方面的主要區別是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q235] Main inventory difference between IFRS and US GAAP?
options_en: IFRS doesn't allow LIFO; US GAAP does
IFRS allows LIFO; US GAAP doesn't
explanation_zh: IFRS禁止LIFO，US GAAP允許LIFO。
explanation_en: IFRS prohibits LIFO; US GAAP permits it.

question_zh: 遞延所得稅資產通常在什麼情況下產生？
question_en: Deferred tax assets arise when:
options_zh: 稅務利潤高於會計利潤
稅務利潤低於會計利潤
explanation_zh: 遞延所得稅資產產生於稅務利潤低於會計利潤的情況。

question_zh: [L2-Q915] 現金流量表中，購買設備屬於什麼活動？
question_en: [L2-Q915] Equipment purchase on cash flow statement is:

question_en: [L2-Q739] What does alpha (α) represent in investment management?
options_zh: 投資組合的超額回報（風險調整後）
explanation_zh: Alpha是投資組合在風險調整後獲得的超額回報，衡量投資經理的技能。
explanation_en: Alpha is the risk-adjusted excess return, measuring investment manager skill.

question_zh: [L2-Q552] 相對估值法的核心思想是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q552] Core idea of relative valuation?
options_zh: 通過比較類似公司估值倍數來評估價值
options_en: Compare valuation multiples of similar companies
explanation_zh: 相對估值通過比較類似公司的P/E、P/B等倍數來評估價值。
explanation_en: Relative valuation compares P/E, P/B multiples of similar companies.

question_zh: [L2-Q827] 期貨逐日結算(Mark-to-Market)是指什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q827] What is mark-to-market for futures?
options_zh: 每日根據結算價調整保證金帳戶
options_en: Daily margin adjustment based on settlement price
explanation_zh: 逐日結算意味著保證金帳戶每日根據結算價格調整。
explanation_en: Mark-to-market means daily margin account adjustment based on settlement prices.

question_zh: [L2-Q969] 房地產投資的Cap Rate計算？
question_en: [L2-Q969] Real estate Cap Rate calculation?
options_zh: 租金收入 / 購買價格
explanation_zh: Cap Rate = NOI / 物業市場價值
explanation_en: Cap Rate = NOI / Property Market Value

question_zh: [L2-Q697] 利率上限(Cap)和利率下限(Floor)的區別？
question_en: [L2-Q697] Difference between interest rate cap and floor?
options_zh: Cap限制利率上限，Floor限制利率下限
options_en: Cap limits rate ceiling; floor limits rate floor
explanation_zh: Cap保護借款人（利率上限），Floor保護貸款人（利率下限）。
explanation_en: Cap protects borrowers (rate ceiling); floor protects lenders (rate floor).

question_zh: [L2-Q508] GIPS要求公司呈報至少多少年的績效表現？
question_en: [L2-Q508] GIPS requires firms to present a minimum of how many years of performance?
explanation_zh: GIPS要求呈報至少5年合規績效，之後每年增加一年，直至至少10年。
explanation_en: GIPS requires a minimum of 5 years of compliant performance, adding one year each year until at least 10 years.

question_zh: [L2-Q675] 比較優勢理論的核心是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q675] What is the core of comparative advantage theory?
options_zh: 各國應專業生產機會成本較低的商品
options_en: Specialize in goods with lower opportunity costs
explanation_zh: 各國應專業化生產機會成本較低的商品並進行貿易。
explanation_en: Countries should specialize in goods with lower opportunity costs and trade.

question_zh: [L2-Q634] 一位基金經理收到上市公司贈送的昂貴禮物，他應該：
question_en: [L2-Q634] A fund manager receives an expensive gift from a public company. He should:
options_zh: 接受但不影響投資決策
拒絕或向僱主披露並獲得許可
options_en: Accept but not let it influence decisions
Decline or disclose to employer and obtain permission
explanation_zh: 應拒絕可能影響獨立性的禮物，或向僱主披露並獲得許可。
explanation_en: Should decline gifts that could impair independence, or disclose to employer and obtain permission.

question_zh: [L2-Q441] 分散化投資可以消除什麼風險？
question_en: [L2-Q441] Diversification eliminates which risk?
options_zh: 非系統性風險（特有風險）
explanation_zh: 分散化可消除非系統性風險，無法消除系統性風險。
explanation_en: Diversification eliminates unsystematic risk, not systematic risk.

question_zh: [L2-Q858] REITs的主要優勢？
question_en: [L2-Q858] Primary advantage of REITs?
options_zh: 房地產投資的流動性和分散化
options_en: Liquidity and diversification for real estate
explanation_zh: REITs提供房地產投資的流動性和分散化。
explanation_en: REITs provide liquidity and diversification for real estate investment.

question_zh: [L2-Q423] 信用利差擴大意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q423] Widening credit spread indicates:
options_zh: 市場對違約風險擔憂增加
explanation_zh: 信用利差擴大反映市場對違約風險的擔憂增加。
explanation_en: Widening spreads reflect increased market concern about default risk.

question_zh: [L2-Q369] IS-LM模型中，擴張性財政政策會導致：
question_en: [L2-Q369] In the IS-LM model, expansionary fiscal policy leads to:
explanation_zh: 擴張性財政政策使IS曲線右移，利率上升，產出增加。
explanation_en: Expansionary fiscal policy shifts IS right, raising interest rates and output.

question_zh: [L2-Q240] 公司治理中「代理問題(Agency Problem)」是指什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q240] What is the 'agency problem' in corporate governance?
options_zh: 管理層與股東之間的利益衝突
explanation_zh: 代理問題是管理層（代理人）可能不以股東（委託人）最佳利益行事的問題。
explanation_en: The agency problem is when management (agents) may not act in shareholders' (principals) best interests.

question_zh: [L2-Q307] 收藏品投資的主要風險？
question_en: [L2-Q307] Primary risk of collectibles?
explanation_zh: 收藏品投資的主要風險是流動性低和估值主觀。
explanation_en: Main risks: low liquidity and subjective valuation.

question_zh: [L2-Q63] 根據CFA標準I(B)，會員在使用重大非公開信息時：
question_en: [L2-Q63] Under CFA Standard I(B), when using material nonpublic information, members:
options_zh: 在獲得僱主批准後可以使用
可以在對沖交易中使用
只要不從中獲利就可以使用
不得利用該信息進行交易或建議他人交易
options_en: May use it with employer approval
May use it in hedging transactions
May use it as long as they don't profit
Must not trade or recommend trades based on such information
explanation_zh: 標準I(B)明確禁止會員利用重大非公開信息進行交易或建議他人交易。
explanation_en: Standard I(B) explicitly prohibits members from trading or recommending trades based on material nonpublic information.

question_zh: [L2-Q446] 商譽在什麼情況下產生？
question_en: [L2-Q446] When does goodwill arise?
options_zh: 收購價格超過淨資產公允價值
options_en: Acquisition price > fair value of net assets
explanation_zh: 商譽在收購價格超過被收購公司可辨認淨資產公允價值時確認。
explanation_en: Goodwill is recognized when acquisition price exceeds fair value of identifiable net assets.

question_zh: [L2-Q984] 到期收益率(YTM)與當期收益率(Current Yield)的區別？
question_en: [L2-Q984] Difference between YTM and current yield?
options_zh: YTM考慮資本利得/損失和再投資，當期收益率只考慮年息/價格
options_en: YTM considers capital gains/loss and reinvestment; current yield only considers annual coupon/price
explanation_zh: YTM是全面的收益率指標，考慮息票再投資和資本利得/損失。
explanation_en: YTM is comprehensive, considering coupon reinvestment and capital gains/losses.

question_zh: [L2-Q899] 敏感度分析的目的是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q899] Purpose of sensitivity analysis?
options_zh: 評估單一變量變化對結果的影響
options_en: Assess impact of single variable change on outcome
explanation_zh: 敏感度分析改變單一變量觀察對結果的影響。
explanation_en: Sensitivity analysis changes one variable to observe its impact on the outcome.

question_zh: [L2-Q252] 杜邦分析將ROE分解為：
question_en: [L2-Q252] DuPont analysis decomposes ROE into:
options_zh: 毛利率×營業利潤率×淨利潤率
流動比率×速動比率×現金比率
利潤率×資產週轉率×權益乘數
explanation_zh: ROE = 利潤率 × 資產週轉率 × 權益乘數
explanation_en: ROE = Profit Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier

question_zh: [L2-Q144] CFA標準III(A)「忠誠、謹慎和關懷」要求會員對客戶承擔什麼義務？
question_en: [L2-Q144] CFA Standard III(A) 'Loyalty, Prudence, and Care' requires members to exercise what duty to clients?
options_zh: 對客戶資產承擔受託責任
將客戶利益置於僱主利益之上
僅向客戶收取固定費用
options_en: Exercise fiduciary duty over client assets
Place client interests above employer interests
Charge only flat fees to clients
explanation_zh: 標準III(A)要求會員對客戶資產承擔受託責任，以客戶的最佳利益行事。
explanation_en: Standard III(A) requires members to exercise fiduciary duty over client assets and act in the best interest of clients.

question_zh: [L2-Q801] 信用利差擴大意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q801] Widening credit spread indicates:
options_zh: 市場對違約風險擔憂增加
explanation_zh: 信用利差擴大反映市場對違約風險的擔憂增加。
explanation_en: Widening spreads reflect increased market concern about default risk.

question_zh: [L2-Q357] 國際收支經常帳赤字意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q357] A current account deficit means:
options_zh: 一國進口超過出口，淨資本流入
options_en: The country has no foreign debt
Imports exceed exports, net capital inflows
explanation_zh: 經常帳赤字意味著進口>出口，需要資本流入來融資。
explanation_en: Current account deficit means imports > exports, requiring capital inflows to finance.

question_zh: [L2-Q145] 行為金融學中「過度自信偏差」？
question_en: [L2-Q145] 'Overconfidence bias' in behavioral finance?
options_zh: 高估自己的知識和預測能力
explanation_zh: 過度自信導致過度交易和承擔過多風險。
explanation_en: Overconfidence leads to excessive trading and risk-taking.

question_zh: [L2-Q418] 信用評級從A下調到BBB，債券價格：
question_en: [L2-Q418] Credit rating downgraded from A to BBB. Bond price:
explanation_zh: 評級下調增加違約風險，信用利差擴大，價格下降。
explanation_en: Downgrade increases default risk, widening spreads, lowering price.

question_zh: [L2-Q832] GDP計算方法不包括以下哪項？
question_en: [L2-Q832] Which is NOT a method of calculating GDP?
explanation_zh: GDP可通過支出法、收入法或生產法計算。「儲蓄法」不是GDP計算方法。
explanation_en: GDP is calculated via expenditure, income, or production approach. 'Savings approach' is not a GDP method.

question_zh: 均值45，標準差9。切比雪夫不等式：至少72%數據落在什麼範圍？
question_en: Mean 55, SD 10.0 Chebyshev: at least 81% of data falls within what range?

question_zh: [L2-Q917] 董事會獨立性的主要目的是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q917] Primary purpose of board independence?
options_zh: 保護股東利益並減少利益衝突
explanation_zh: 獨立董事客觀監督管理層，保護股東利益。
explanation_en: Independent directors objectively oversee management and protect shareholder interests.

question_zh: [L2-Q183] 收益率曲線向上傾斜時，哪類債券YTM最高？
question_en: [L2-Q183] Upward-sloping yield curve: which bonds have highest YTM?
explanation_zh: 向上傾斜曲線意味著長期債券收益率更高。
explanation_en: Upward slope means long-term bonds have higher yields.

question_zh: [L2-Q992] GDP計算方法不包括以下哪項？
question_en: [L2-Q992] Which is NOT a method of calculating GDP?
explanation_zh: GDP可通過支出法、收入法或生產法計算。「儲蓄法」不是GDP計算方法。
explanation_en: GDP is calculated via expenditure, income, or production approach. 'Savings approach' is not a GDP method.

question_zh: [L2-Q992] 看漲期權買方的最大損失？
question_en: [L2-Q992] Maximum loss for call option buyer?
explanation_zh: 買方最大損失僅限於期權費。
explanation_en: Buyer's maximum loss is limited to the premium paid.

question_zh: [L2-Q859] 間接法現金流量表中，折舊費用如何處理？
question_en: [L2-Q859] In the indirect method, depreciation is:
explanation_zh: 折舊是非現金費用，加回到淨利潤中。
explanation_en: Depreciation is a non-cash expense added back to net income.

question_zh: [L2-Q581] 分散化投資可以消除什麼風險？
question_en: [L2-Q581] Diversification eliminates which risk?
options_zh: 非系統性風險（特有風險）
explanation_zh: 分散化可消除非系統性風險，無法消除系統性風險。
explanation_en: Diversification eliminates unsystematic risk, not systematic risk.

question_zh: F檢驗在回歸分析中的用途是什麼？
question_en: What is the F-test used for in regression?
options_zh: 檢驗回歸模型整體顯著性
explanation_zh: F檢驗用於檢驗回歸模型的整體顯著性。
explanation_en: The F-test tests the overall significance of the regression model.

question_zh: [L2-Q390] 以下哪項行為違反了CFA標準VI(B)「交易優先權」？
question_en: [L2-Q390] Which action violates CFA Standard VI(B) 'Priority of Transactions'?
options_zh: 在客戶交易之前為個人帳戶交易
客戶交易完成後為個人帳戶交易
options_en: Trading for personal account before client trades
Trading for personal account after client trades
explanation_zh: 標準VI(B)要求客戶交易優先於個人交易。
explanation_en: Standard VI(B) requires client transactions take priority over personal transactions.

question_zh: [L2-Q768] REITs的主要優勢？
question_en: [L2-Q768] Primary advantage of REITs?
options_zh: 房地產投資的流動性和分散化
options_en: Liquidity and diversification for real estate
explanation_zh: REITs提供房地產投資的流動性和分散化。
explanation_en: REITs provide liquidity and diversification for real estate investment.

question_zh: [L2-Q750] 邊際消費傾向(MPC)為0.8時，財政乘數是多少？
question_en: [L2-Q750] MPC = 0.8. What is the fiscal multiplier?
explanation_en: Multiplier = 1/(1-MPC) = 1/(1-0.8) = 5

question_zh: [L2-Q583] 期權時間價值在什麼時候最大？
question_en: [L2-Q583] When is an option's time value greatest?
explanation_zh: 時間價值在平值時最大，因為不確定性最高。
explanation_en: Time value is greatest at the money, when uncertainty is highest.

question_zh: [L2-Q408] GIPS要求公司呈報至少多少年的績效表現？
question_en: [L2-Q408] GIPS requires firms to present a minimum of how many years of performance?
explanation_zh: GIPS要求呈報至少5年合規績效，之後每年增加一年，直至至少10年。
explanation_en: GIPS requires a minimum of 5 years of compliant performance, adding one year each year until at least 10 years.

question_zh: [L2-Q343] 票面利率5%，市場利率上升到6%。債券價格將：
question_en: [L2-Q343] Coupon 5%, market rates rise to 6%. Bond price will:
explanation_zh: 債券價格與市場利率呈反向關係。
explanation_en: Bond prices and interest rates have an inverse relationship.

question_zh: [L2-Q966] 菲利普斯曲線描述了哪兩個變量的關係？
question_en: [L2-Q966] The Phillips curve describes the relationship between:
options_zh: 貨幣供應量與物價水平
explanation_zh: 菲利普斯曲線描述失業率與通脹率的短期反向關係。
explanation_en: The Phillips curve describes the short-run inverse relationship between unemployment and inflation.

question_zh: [L2-Q713] YTM假設什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q713] What does YTM assume?
options_zh: 息票以YTM再投資，持有至到期
options_en: Coupons reinvested at YTM, held to maturity
explanation_zh: YTM假設所有息票以YTM再投資，且持有至到期。
explanation_en: YTM assumes all coupons reinvested at YTM and bond held to maturity.

question_zh: [L2-Q748] 大宗商品期貨的「期貨溢價(Backwardation)」是指什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q748] What is 'backwardation' in commodity futures?
options_zh: 期貨價格高於現貨價格
現貨價格高於期貨價格
explanation_zh: Backwardation是現貨價格高於期貨價格的市場結構。
explanation_en: Backwardation is a market structure where spot price exceeds futures price.

question_zh: [L2-Q897] Vega代表什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q897] What does vega represent?
options_zh: 期權價格對利率的敏感度
期權價格對時間的敏感度
期權價格對波動率變化的敏感度
期權價格對標的價格的敏感度
options_en: Option price sensitivity to volatility changes
explanation_zh: Vega衡量標的資產波動率變動1%時期權價格的變動。
explanation_en: Vega measures the option price change for a 1% change in underlying volatility.

question_zh: 遠期合約與期貨合約的主要區別？
question_en: Main difference between forwards and futures?
options_zh: 遠期OTC交易，期貨交易所交易
explanation_zh: 遠期在場外交易(OTC)，期貨在交易所交易並有中央清算。
explanation_en: Forwards trade OTC; futures trade on exchanges with central clearing.

question_zh: [L2-Q524] WACC的計算中，債務成本通常使用什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q524] In WACC calculation, debt cost typically uses:
options_zh: 稅後債務成本（考慮利息抵稅）
explanation_zh: WACC中使用稅後債務成本，因為利息支出有抵稅效果。
explanation_en: WACC uses after-tax cost of debt because interest payments provide a tax shield.

question_zh: [L2-Q441] 一個6×9 FRA中的「6」和「9」代表什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q441] In a 6×9 FRA, what do '6' and '9' represent?
options_zh: 合約開始於6個月後，結束於9個月後
options_en: Starts in 6 months, ends in 9 months
explanation_zh: 6×9 FRA在6個月後開始，涵蓋6到9個月的利率。
explanation_en: 6×9 FRA starts in 6 months, covering the rate from month 6 to 9.

question_zh: [L2-Q733] 價值型股票(Value Stock)的特點是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q733] Characteristics of value stocks?
options_en: High P/E, high P/B, low dividend yield
Low P/E, low P/B, high dividend yield
explanation_zh: 價值型股票通常具有低P/E、低P/B和高股息率的特點。
explanation_en: Value stocks typically have low P/E, low P/B, and high dividend yields.

question_zh: [L2-Q280] EVA（經濟增加值）的計算公式是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q280] What is the EVA (Economic Value Added) formula?
options_zh: 銷售收入 - 銷售成本
營業收入 - 營業費用
explanation_zh: EVA = NOPAT - (WACC × 投入資本)，衡量公司是否創造了超過資本成本的價值。
explanation_en: EVA = NOPAT - (WACC × Invested Capital), measuring whether a company creates value above its cost of capital.

question_zh: [L2-Q785] 敏感度分析的目的是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q785] Purpose of sensitivity analysis?
options_zh: 評估單一變量變化對結果的影響
options_en: Assess impact of single variable change on outcome
explanation_zh: 敏感度分析改變單一變量觀察對結果的影響。
explanation_en: Sensitivity analysis changes one variable to observe its impact on the outcome.

question_zh: [L2-Q450] 收益率曲線倒掛(Inverted Yield Curve)通常預示什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q450] An inverted yield curve typically signals:
explanation_zh: 收益率曲線倒掛（短期利率高於長期利率）是經濟衰退的可靠預測指標。
explanation_en: An inverted yield curve (short rates > long rates) is a reliable predictor of economic recession.

question_zh: [L2-Q301] 根據CFA Institute道德準則，CFA會員和考生必須：
question_en: [L2-Q301] According to the CFA Institute Code of Ethics, CFA members and candidates must:
options_zh: 優先考慮僱主的利益而非客戶利益
僅以盈利為目標進行投資決策
以專業和道德的方式行事，將客戶利益置於自身利益之上
僅在監管要求下才披露利益衝突
options_en: Prioritize employer interests over client interests
Make investment decisions solely to maximize profits
Act with integrity, placing clients' interests above their own
Disclose conflicts only when required by regulators
explanation_zh: CFA道德準則要求會員以專業、正直、勤勉和尊重的態度行事，並將客戶利益置於自身利益之上。
explanation_en: The CFA Code of Ethics requires members to act with integrity, competence, diligence, and respect, placing clients' interests above their own.

question_zh: [L2-Q992] EPS為$2，股價$40。P/E是多少？
question_en: [L2-Q992] EPS=$2, price=$40. P/E ratio?

question_zh: [L2-Q616] 毛利率公式是什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q616] What is the gross profit margin formula?

question_zh: [L2-Q602] 正的久期缺口意味著什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q602] Positive duration gap means:
options_zh: 資產久期>負債久期，利率上升對淨值不利
options_en: Asset duration > liability; rising rates hurt net worth
explanation_zh: 正久期缺口：資產久期>負債久期，利率上升時淨值下降。
explanation_en: Positive gap: asset duration > liability duration, rising rates reduce net worth.

question_zh: [L2-Q502] CAPM中，資產期望回報取決於什麼？
question_en: [L2-Q502] In CAPM, expected return depends on:
options_zh: 無風險利率、市場風險溢價和Beta
options_en: Risk-free rate, market risk premium, and Beta
